create_pydantic_dataclass: create a dataclass using the custom pydantic-aware dataclass decorator from reagent
create_vanilla_dataclass: create a vanilla dataclass by setting USE_VANILLA_DATACLASS env var to 1
use_post_init_post_parse: define a dataclass with __post_init_post_parse__ for post-parse validation logic
use_dataclass_field: use the re-exported dataclasses.field to set default values on dataclass fields
configure_arbitrary_types: set ARBITRARY_TYPES_ALLOWED env var to enable arbitrary types in pydantic dataclasses
